failures.claim: Authentication__CookieName env var can override Cookie.Name
failures.expected: Code reads Cookie.Name from IConfiguration via Authentication:CookieName key
failures.actual: Program.cs hardcodes Cookie.Name to 'Motherson.BoxManagement.Auth' (line 30) without reading from configuration; env var has no effect

failures.claim: Authentication__ExpireTimeSpanMinutes env var can override ExpireTimeSpan
failures.expected: Code reads ExpireTimeSpan from IConfiguration via Authentication:ExpireTimeSpanMinutes key
failures.actual: Program.cs hardcodes ExpireTimeSpan to TimeSpan.FromMinutes(60) (line 35) without reading from configuration; env var has no effect

failures.claim: Authentication parameters can be overridden via env vars with prefix Authentication__
failures.expected: Authentication settings are read from IConfiguration, allowing env var overrides
failures.actual: All 6 authentication settings (Cookie.Name, HttpOnly, SameSite, SecurePolicy, SlidingExpiration, ExpireTimeSpan, LoginPath, AccessDeniedPath) are hardcoded in Program.cs (lines 30-37) and cannot be overridden via env vars

failures.expected: Application reads Cookie.Name from configuration key Authentication:CookieName
failures.actual: Program.cs hardcodes Cookie.Name; user-secrets key would have no effect

failures.expected: Application reads ExpireTimeSpan from configuration key Authentication:ExpireTimeSpanMinutes
failures.actual: Program.cs hardcodes ExpireTimeSpan; user-secrets key would have no effect

failures.claim: Authentication__CookieName and Authentication__ExpireTimeSpanMinutes env vars for production
failures.expected: Application reads these values from IConfiguration to configure authentication
failures.actual: Authentication config is hardcoded in Program.cs; these env vars have no effect on application behavior
